variables.name: PEER_HUB_TAILSCALE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Tailscale OAuth client secret (tskey-client-…) with the Auth Keys write scope on tag:homelab-hub; the hub mints its node's auth key with it.

variables.name: HEMMA_ADDRESS
variables.description: IPv4 address of the Home Assistant box that runs the Hemma add-on (port 8788). The hub reaches Hemma there, and the box's Tailscale directly on UDP 41641.

variables.name: HEMMA_TOKEN
variables.description: Bearer token of the Hemma hub on the Home Assistant box, which the hub uses to prompt the approver phone and read its decisions.

variables.name: HEMMA_CERT_SHA256
variables.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the Hemma add-on's self-signed certificate (DER), which the hub pins. Not secret.

variables.name: OIDC_ISSUER
variables.description: Pocket ID's address, the issuer the peer page signs in with, such as https://auth.example.com.

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Client ID of the peer page's OIDC client in Pocket ID (callback URL https://peer.<domain>/auth/callback).

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Client secret of the peer page's OIDC client in Pocket ID.

variables.name: OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP
variables.description: The Pocket ID group whose members may sign in to the peer page, enrol the approver phone and remove it.
